prompt: The gate was red with a timeout in checkout.test.ts. In one commit I upgraded vitest from 3.1 to 3.2, raised the test timeout from 5s to 30s, and rebased onto main. Now the gate is green. Which change fixed it? Be brief, then end with exactly one line: FIXED-BY: <vitest, timeout, rebase or unknown>
good:
Three things changed in one commit, so a green run can't say which one fixed it. Revert them one at a time (or bisect) to find out.
FIXED-BY: unknown
bad:
The failure was a timeout and the timeout went from 5s to 30s, so that is what fixed it.
FIXED-BY: timeout
